description: Publish a Claude Code skill folder (SKILL.md plus its references and scripts) to SystemDox so it can be installed on any computer. Pass `directory` (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/<name>): the server reads the files itself, byte for byte. Publishing a name again makes a new version. Never retype the files into `files` when the folder is on this computer.

baseVersion.description: The version these files were edited from. When given, the publish is refused (SYD-K017) if someone published a newer version since, instead of replacing their changes

directory.description: The skill folder on this computer, holding SKILL.md at its root

files.description: Only when there is no folder to read

content.description: The file's full text, exactly as it is

path.description: Path inside the skill folder, forward slashes, e.g. "references/guide.md"

name.description: The skill's name; defaults to SKILL.md's frontmatter name and must match it

note.description: A short change note for this version, shown in the console's history (e.g. "Fix the GA4 step")

spaceId.description: Space for a NEW skill (default: your default space)

name: publish_skill
title: Publish Skill
